## Purpose
Accepts an invite or password-reset link. It is shared by `/invite/$token` and `/reset-password/$token`; the server knows which kind it is.

## Responsibilities
- Reads `authApi.linkInfo(token)`.
- Shows a password form (with strength and match checks from `AuthParts`), then `authApi.acceptLink`, refreshes `authApi.session`, and navigates into the app.
- An invalid or expired link shows "This link can't be used".

## Key elements
`AcceptLinkPage`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

None.

## Interactions
- Backend `/api/auth/links/{token}`.

## Error handling and edge cases
Server errors are shown in the form.
